carbon.report.intro: Germany's Climate Protection Act sets a reduction path for the greenhouse-gas emissions of every sector. German agriculture emitted about 56.1 million t CO₂ equivalents in 2020, 7.7 % of Germany's emissions. The main sources are methane from livestock and nitrous oxide from agricultural soils; manure management, liming and urea together contribute almost a quarter (Thünen Institute 2022). This report balances the farm's crop production with the BEK method.

vra.explainer.step1.body: Each zone of the chosen zoning has a relative yield (100 % = field mean): measured for productivity zones and yield maps; for soil zones and satellite scenes a conservative spread from 80 % for the weakest to 120 % for the strongest zone.
vra.explainer.step1.title: 1. Relative yield per zone
vra.explainer.step2.body: Proportional: higher productivity → higher rate. Inverse puts more on weak zones, e.g. for P and K, compensating strategies or humus-rich zones that release more N.
vra.explainer.step2.title: 2. Direction
vra.explainer.step3.body: The relative yields are scaled so their area-weighted mean is 1.0: Σ (rate × area) = standard rate × area as long as no zone is clipped.
vra.explainer.step3.title: 3. Area-weighted normalization
vra.explainer.step4.body: No zone gets less than 65 % or more than 135 % of the standard rate. When a zone is clipped the total differs slightly; the total below the table shows it.
vra.explainer.step4.title: 4. Clipping
vra.explainer.step5.body: Optionally each rate is rounded to the nearest multiple of 1, 5, 10 or 25. That makes the map spreader-friendly; the total may drift by a few kilograms.
vra.explainer.step5.title: 5. Spreader resolution

zones.method: Each acquisition is divided by its field mean, averaged per season and then over the seasons, so every season counts the same. Stability is the mean correlation of each season's pattern with the other seasons. Zones are natural breaks (k-means) of the productivity map, cleaned of small patches. Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data.
